subject: the Thaw Max defrosting tray, a slim matte black grooved aluminum tray, lying flat on a cream plaster counter in front of a deep green wall, with one raw boneless chicken breast thawing on it.

promo.headline: Your microwave is ruining good meat.

cta.headline: Thaw it clean. Never microwave again.

note: Plain aluminum, no coating, no cord. Keep the panel flat and the type large enough to read at 200 pixels wide on a phone: headline at least 8% of the image height, everything else at least 3%.
